name: redactguard
description: The Zero-Trust Data Sanitization & Compliance Suite - Erradica filtraciones por redacciones defectuosas

scripts.build:web: npm run build:wasm && npm run build -w @redactguard/web
scripts.build:cli: cargo build --release -p redactguard-bin && mkdir -p apps/cli/bin && (cp target/release/redactguard apps/cli/bin/ 2>/dev/null || cp target/release/redactguard.exe apps/cli/bin/ 2>/dev/null) && npm run build -w @redactguard/cli
scripts.test: cargo test -p redactguard-core && npm run test --workspaces --if-present

author: RedactGuard Team
